test_description: Test direct pCloud API call to verify authentication and response structure
commit_message:
Implement pCloud API authentication debug functionality

- Add debugPCloudAPIAuthentication() method to MusicDiscoveryService
- Create PCloudAPIDebugInfo data class for comprehensive API response capture  
- Integrate debug calls into MusicHubViewModel.loadData() workflow
- Add PCloudAPIAuthenticationDebugTest with real credentials support
- Fixed compilation errors with proper Exception type handling
- Debug logging now captures auth token, response size, duration, and raw API data

This addresses PLY-148 by providing comprehensive debugging to understand why 
music discovery returns empty results despite successful authentication.
